'''Bathens''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] who served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith-Empire]].

==Biography==
During the [[Battle of Corellia]] in [[3640 BBY]], he and [[Trigo Shane]] tasked a Republic hero to sabotage a hangar full of Imperial [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] before they could take flight and annihilate the Republic's forces.
